name: Management
description: Oversees business strategy, planning, decision-making, and overall company performance.

name: Human Resources
description: Handles recruitment, employee records, onboarding, attendance, leave, and employee welfare.

name: Accounts & Finance
description: Manages accounting, financial statements, payments, receipts, budgeting, and financial reporting.

name: Sales
description: Handles sales activities, customer relationships, quotations, orders, and revenue generation.

name: Marketing
description: Manages advertising, promotions, branding, campaigns, and market research.

name: Purchase & Procurement
description: Handles supplier selection, purchase requests, purchase orders, and procurement activities.

name: Inventory & Warehouse
description: Manages stock, warehouses, goods receipts, stock transfers, and inventory adjustments.

name: Production
description: Plans and manages manufacturing, production orders, material consumption, and output.

name: Quality Control
description: Inspects materials and products and maintains quality standards and compliance.

name: Logistics & Transportation
description: Manages shipments, deliveries, transportation, dispatch, and distribution.

name: Customer Support
description: Handles customer queries, complaints, service requests, and after-sales support.

name: Information Technology
description: Manages software, hardware, networks, technical support, and IT infrastructure.

name: Administration
description: Handles office administration, facilities, company assets, and general administrative activities.

name: Legal & Compliance
description: Manages contracts, legal documentation, regulatory compliance, and legal matters.

name: Research & Development
description: Develops new products, improves existing products, and conducts research and innovation.

name: Operations
description: Oversees day-to-day business processes and operational efficiency.

name: Project Management
description: Plans, tracks, and coordinates projects, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.

name: Service & Maintenance
description: Handles equipment maintenance, repairs, installations, and field service activities.

name: Import & Export
description: Manages international trade documentation, customs, export orders, and import shipments.

name: Internal Audit
description: Reviews internal controls, financial processes, operational risks, and company policies.
